translationRepairs: Only Song Gui and Pan Shouheng were fairly able to remonstrate with the Xuande and Aizong emperors and at times were of benefit — outstanding among hirelings, ringing like iron.
Only Song Gui and Pan Shouheng were fairly able to remonstrate with the Xuanzong and Aizong emperors and at times were of benefit — outstanding among hirelings, ringing like iron.
s0009 has 諷諫宣、哀, abbreviating Jin temple names 宣宗 and 哀宗; Xuande is a different era name and wrongly renders 宣, while Xuanzong matches the Chinese and the parallel idiomatic line.
When Guannu went to Bo Prefecture, Gui secretly joined the palace attendant Wugusun Aishi, Nalan Geda, the guardswoman Xilie Wanchu, Fan Chenseng, Wang Shan'er, and others in a plot to kill him.

護衛女奚烈完出 names a 護衛 (guard) whose Jurchen surname is 女奚烈; the 女 is part of the clan name, not 'woman', so 'guardswoman' invents sex and 'the guard' is the accurate repair.
